title: OkumaTouchpad
intro: Customize native touchpad behavior. Preview before applying. Existing gesture bindings must be migrated manually. No changes are applied automatically.
applyFailed: Apply failed. New settings were not saved. Review the details below.
applySucceeded: Applied and saved. Loader and global options verified; test physical gestures below.
operationFailed: Operation failed. Review the details below.
readFailed: Could not read settings. Review the details below.
launcherFailed: Application entry registration failed. Run python3 launcher.py install from the plugin directory.
unsaved: Draft changes have not been applied. Reload saved discards the draft.
explicit: Apply saves settings and reloads Hyprland with validation and rollback.
setting.clickfinger: Use finger count for physical clicks
setting.threeFingerSpread: Extra three-finger spread action (may conflict with dragging)
